body:
After several attempts at making an ayahuasca like experience using pure DMT, harmine, and harmaline, I gave up. No matter what the ratio of harmine to harmaline, the effect was still not like try ayahuasca.
I found a place that sold harmine and harmaline at a farely good price. I added 400 mg of harmine and 200 mg of harmaline to my cart. Then I noticed something Ive not seen before at such a reasonable price. It was tetrahydroharmine. It was less than ten bucks for 200 mg. I never saw that before at such a low price. I knew that tetrahydroharmine was present in ayahuasca, sometimes in farely large amounts. I added 300 mg to my cart.
After a few days the package arrived in the mail. I was quite excited. I had no idea what tetrahydroharmine was going to add to the pharmahuasca experience. I also didnt know how much to use. I searched and searched the internet for recipes and could find very little information on tetrahydroharmine other than a mention a single report in TiHKAl of someone taking 300 mg and saying it was similar to harmiline. That was it.
So I decided to do some of my own research into the matter and came up with the following recipe:
40 mg of freebase DMT
55 mg of freebase harmine
5 mg of freebase harmaline
50 mg of tetrahydroharmine HCl (they didnt sell it as freebase)
This approximates the average amounts of each chemical as found in ayahuasca (rounded to the nearest 5 mg dose).
I placed it in a gel capsule and drank it down with a glass of water. Within a few minutes a pleasant tingling sensation was felt with mild euphoria, which reminded me ayahuasca. After about 30 minutes the effects were beautiful. The DMT was just started to be noticed. The feeling was so far exactly like that of real ayahuasca.
The overall effects were mild. During the peak there were visuals, and with the eyes closed I saw the earth spinning in space surrounded by stars. It was faint. I think the overall dose was small for me. But it was exactly like real ayahuasca in every way, except I didnt feel any nausea at all.
THH was definitely the missing piece in all my previous attempts at making pharmahuasca. With the THH in the mix, theres a loving peaceful feeling to the whole experience. I also noticed the experience lasted about an hour longer than it normally does without the THH.
After that experience I then tried THH alone without any other things. The dose tried was 300 mg. I expected it to be like harmaline. It was actually nothing like harmaline or harmine. It was very different. I felt tingly all over and euphoric. My mood was enhanced and I felt peaceful. During the peak (at about 2 1/2 hours) things looked sparkly and I had a few faint visions. I saw an impression of a face appear on the wall. It was a happy smiling face. It was faint and faded away. I then started seeing patterns all over the wall. Again, it was faint. I decided to close my eyes and relax. This gave way to a very peaceful experience. I started having visions and people dancing. It not color, all the visions were faint and colorless. I watched as they danced. They slowly transformed into flowers blowing in the wind. This faded and the visions came to an end.
During the whole experience I felt very clear headed and alert. I was surprised to actually have some faint visual effects from it. It was almost as if I had taken a very small amount of DMT with it, but I had not.
Im glad to have discovered THH. Its made all my pharmahuasca experiences far better. Just like the real thing, but without the nausea.
